import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    q = np.sqrt(T); L = np.log(T)
    g = (params[0] + params[1]*q + params[2]*T + params[3]*T**2 + params[4]*T**3
         + params[5]*L + params[6]*T*L + params[7]/T + params[8]*q*L)
    return g + params[9]*q*eps**2
